nameJa: グラファイトと赤いアクリル
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 落ち着いたグラファイト地、白いタイプと赤い半透明チャット。控えめな物理的な奥行きで機能を示す。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Design one sophisticated Chrome Web Store promotional tile, landscape 11:7, target 1760 × 1120 pixels, edge-to-edge. The product is a browser extension that keeps live chat inside fullscreen YouTube video.
Art direction: restrained high-end graphic design with a soft graphite background, exact white typography, and a single small red frosted-acrylic element. Beautiful studio-lit physical depth, very subtle material grain and contact shadows, mainly flat and architectural, never a generic 3D tech illustration.
Composition: “YouTube” in clean white medium-weight type at top left. “Fullscreen” as a large white headline below it, one unbroken word. “Live Chat” as a large white second line directly below. The lower half holds a broad landscape 16:9 screen made of four clean white fullscreen corner brackets with very faint transparent graphite fill. A white play triangle rests in its left area. Fully INSIDE the right side of that same screen rests one translucent saturated red chat pane, a thin precisely formed acrylic slab, with three abstract opaque white horizontal strokes. No bubbles floating outside the fullscreen corners. Elegant restrained dimensionality, not neon. Text is genuinely typographically designed, perfectly spelled and sharp.
Visible text exactly once per phrase and no additional text: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. All phrases must be clearly legible when this image is viewed at 220 × 140. Keep every letter and diagram comfortably inside 7% margins and never overlap the text and screen. Use negative space intentionally. No tagline, badge, numbering, watermark.
No humans, avatars, names, game world, photos, fake chat text, dashboards, UI chrome, browser toolbar, generic gradient blobs, chrome materials, neon glow, blue/purple accents, holograms or ornamental clutter. Only the fullscreen-video-plus-inside-chat concept, polished graphite, white and restrained red.
revisionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this single reference promotional graphic. Keep its exact graphite, soft white and frosted red acrylic material quality, clean type and simple full-screen video / chat concept. Correct ONLY composition: the black video screen bounded by the four white fullscreen brackets must become a clear 16:9 landscape rectangle, not the current ultra-wide rectangle. Put it on the RIGHT half of a landscape 11:7 canvas. Stack the same three exact text phrases at LEFT, taking around 42% width, all comfortably readable: “YouTube” (smaller), “Fullscreen” (one unbroken word), “Live Chat” (one line). Make the whole artwork exactly 1760 × 1120 or the same 11:7 aspect ratio. Keep all letters inside 7% inset. Screen right half width about 47% of canvas and height exactly width × 9/16, centered vertically; white play triangle left within it and red transparent acrylic chat pane fully INSIDE its right area. Maintain subtly beautiful physical materials, no added ornament. Only visible words each exactly once: YouTube, Fullscreen, Live Chat. No extra text, numbers, badges or watermark. The major correction is compact 16:9 screen beside typography.
visualReview: Corrected the initial overly wide screen with a compact landscape screen beside the three required text phrases. Red acrylic chat pane is fully inside the fullscreen boundary. Native artwork is approximately 11:7, 1572×1001.
